rationale: English beaver means both the animal and vulgar slang for vagina, setting up the correction after194. Thai194 transliterates only บีเวอร์ and195 merely says not vagina, without making that slang link available. The target retains the facts but the intended double-meaning joke becomes an unexplained non sequitur. Parent should adjudicate an explicit compact slang bridge rather than changing the established species name.
